_: いま持っているもの・出願で使えるものを、項目ごとに置きます。各項目は、何か（what）、証拠の URL（evidence）、状態（status）、公式の頁の扱い（official）と、その元の英語の文と出典（official_quotes）を持ちます。
evidence は、運営者のリポジトリにすでにある公開の URL か null です。official_quotes の source は、2026-11-20 に開いて読んだ頁（data/requirements.json の pages_read）のどれかで、quote はその頁の文を一字一句そのまま置きます。
状態は statuses の三つのどれかです。成績・点・GPA など、個人の学業の記録は書きません。
recommendation_slots は、推薦の枠ごとの状態だけを持ちます。人の名、所属、学校、SNS、分野、肩書き、間柄、予定は書きません（決めごと 6）。recommendation_guidance は、公式の頁が推薦者をどう扱っているかの文です。

items.what: CS50x（HarvardX）の edX の修了証。計算機科学の入門で、C・Python・SQL・Web の課題と最終課題を出して修了した。verified の種類の修了証かどうかは、ここでは確かめていない
items.what_en: The edX certificate of CS50x (HarvardX), an introduction to computer science, completed with the problem sets in C, Python, SQL and the Web and a final project. Whether it is a verified certificate is not confirmed here
items.evidence_note: cpsbvbng26-dotcom の README の修了証の欄にある URL。edX の頁は、2026-11-20 にこの作業の環境から開けなかった（接続が 403 で断られた）。
items.official: 検証済みの修了証のある MOOC は考慮されうるが、単位の付く授業ほど厳密で記録の整ったものはまれ。ほかの MOOC の提供者の単位にならない課程も、足りるとされることはまれ。成績の付かない、単位にならない MOOC の類の学習は、出願に並べない
items.official_en: MOOCs with verified certificates may be considered, but they are rarely as rigorous and well documented as for-credit classes. Non-credit courses from other MOOC providers are rarely considered sufficient. Non-graded, non-academic-credit MOOC-type coursework is not listed

official_quotes.quote: Other objectively-documented credentials may be considered—such as MOOCs with verified certificates and bootcamps—but it is rare that such instructional settings are as rigorous and well-documented as for-credit classes at recognized academic institutions.
Similarly, non-credit courses and curricula from other MOOC providers, bootcamp providers, etc. are rarely considered sufficient.
DO NOT list non-graded, non-academic-credit MOOC-type coursework.

items.official: 望ましい資格を満たさない出願のために、この課程を、中の評価と試験まで含めて終えることを勧めている。終えても入学は保証されず、STEM の学士号の無い人には、これだけで足りることはまれ
items.official_en: For applicants without the preferred qualifications, the page recommends completing these verified certificate tracks, including all embedded assessments and exams. Completing them does not guarantee admission, and they alone are rarely sufficient without a bachelor's degree in a STEM field

official_quotes.quote: We recommend completing the verified certificate tracks (including all embedded assessments and exams) for the following three Georgia Tech professional certificate programs.
Completing them does not guarantee admission to the program
Specifically, these MOOCs alone are rarely sufficient for those who do not hold a Bachelor's or higher level degree in a STEM field.

items.what: 学士号。在学中で、まだ得ていない。大学の名は書かない
items.what_en: A bachelor's degree, in progress and not yet earned. The university is not named
items.evidence_note: 大学の名を書かないので、証拠の URL も置かない。
items.official: 入学までに、学士号か同等以上の学位が要る。在学中の学位の成績証明書が出願の日より 30 日を超えて古いのは、よくある問題として挙がっている。締め切りのあとに終えた学業は評価に入らない
items.official_en: A bachelor's degree, its equivalent or a higher degree is required before matriculation. A transcript for a degree in progress more than 30 days older than the application date is listed as a common problem. Academic work completed after the deadline is not considered

official_quotes.quote: Evidence of award of a bachelor's degree, its equivalent, or higher degree (prior to matriculation) from a regionally accredited institution
Transcripts for in-progress degrees that are out-of-date (meaning >30 days older than the application date).
Please note that any academic work completed after the application deadline will not be considered for the purposes of evaluating your application.

items.what: 公開のリポジトリと、その機械の検査。プログラムを書いた記録。補足の書類として出すなら、Professional Development の欄に上げることになる
items.what_en: The public repositories and their machine checks, a record of programming. Given as a supporting document, it would go in the Professional Development area
items.evidence_note: cpsbvbng26-dotcom の index.html と cv.html にある URL。この作業の環境から curl で開くと 403 が返り、頁そのものは開いていない。
items.official: 補足の書類は、出願の Professional Development の欄に上げる。望ましい資格を満たさない出願では、客観的に記録された計算機科学の力が見られる。読んだ頁は、公開のコードの扱いを書いていない。重く見ているのは、単位の付く上級の授業をこなせることである
items.official_en: Supporting documents go in the Professional Development area. For applicants without the preferred qualifications, objectively documented capability in computer science is looked for. The pages read do not say how public code is treated. What they weigh is the ability to do upper level for-credit coursework

official_quotes.quote: Upload into the Professional Development area of your application any supporting documents (except transcripts, which should be uploaded into the Academic History area).
In these cases, the Admissions Committee is looking for a demonstrated, objectively documented basic capability and knowledge in computer science.
it is interested in your demonstrating the ability to perform upper level computer science academic coursework.

items.official: 出願を強くする最もよい道は、ACM と IEEE の Computer Science Curricula 2013 を手がかりに、上級の科目を 2 から 4 つ選び、B 以上を取れることを示すこと。成績証明書は大学から出るもので、MOOC の提供者のような第三者のものではいけない

official_quotes.quote: The best way to strengthen your application is to refer to Computer Science Curricula 2013
Find 2-4 upper-level (i.e., junior, senior, or graduate level) courses of interest that cover some of these areas and demonstrate the ability to earn a B or better in those courses.
this must come from the university, not a third-party intermediary or platform such as a MOOC provider.
